indicators.definition: Ever told by a health professional that they have diabetes; excludes diabetes only during pregnancy.
indicators.interpretation_note: Self-reported diagnosis; undiagnosed diabetes is not captured.
indicators.formula_expression: CDC model-based adult prevalence, age-adjusted for county comparison; not computed from ACS counts.

indicators.definition: Ever told by a health professional that they have high blood pressure; excludes pregnancy-only and borderline hypertension.
indicators.interpretation_note: Self-reported diagnosis rather than measured blood pressure.
indicators.formula_expression: CDC model-based adult prevalence, age-adjusted for county comparison; not computed from ACS counts.

indicators.definition: Ever told by a health professional that they have angina or coronary heart disease.
indicators.interpretation_note: Does not represent every form of cardiovascular disease.
indicators.formula_expression: CDC model-based adult prevalence, age-adjusted for county comparison; not computed from ACS counts.

indicators.definition: Ever diagnosed with asthma and reports still having asthma.
indicators.interpretation_note: Current asthma, not lifetime asthma history.
indicators.formula_expression: CDC model-based adult prevalence, age-adjusted for county comparison; not computed from ACS counts.

indicators.definition: Ever told by a health professional that they have COPD, emphysema, or chronic bronchitis.
indicators.interpretation_note: Self-reported diagnosis; includes emphysema and chronic bronchitis.
indicators.formula_expression: CDC model-based adult prevalence, age-adjusted for county comparison; not computed from ACS counts.

indicators.definition: Ever told by a health professional that they have a depressive disorder, including depression, major depression, dysthymia, or minor depression.
indicators.interpretation_note: Lifetime diagnosis history, not current symptoms or current major depressive disorder.
indicators.formula_expression: CDC model-based adult prevalence, age-adjusted for county comparison; not computed from ACS counts.
